item.title: Version 3.5.1
item.description: - **PDFs from Ross:** ask for a PDF, sheet or handout and Ross writes the whole thing and offers it as a document card with Open, Save PDF… and Save to Notes. No more "I can't make a PDF", and no more PDFs holding only a one-line summary. - **Scroll while Ross answers:** you can scroll up while an answer is still coming in; "Jump to latest" brings you back. Same in the Assistant and the Notes Ask panel. - **Export window:** the options at the top no longer squeeze together; a divider line (---) prints as a line. - **Snippets keywords:** typing a keyword like ;ext then space now works in email drafts, not just Notes. - **Blanks:** [Name]-style blanks are highlighted and Tab jumps to them, like {name}. - **Delete:** snippets and drafts have a visible Delete button.
